requiredRuntimeDimensions.question: May this actor see/use this Face App definition?
May this actor see the specific object the Face is bound to?
May this actor read the specific source field/relationship/projection used by the Face?
Should a sensitive portion of a Face be omitted for this actor?
May this actor execute a TRAN$ACT action? Read permission never implies write/action permission.

securityRules: Runtime authorization is authoritative; designer visibility is not security.
Unauthorized sensitive sections should be omitted rather than replaced by revealing access-denied placeholders when the section existence is sensitive.
Chat/AI compiler receives only an authorized Face Data Manifest for the current actor/company/object definition.
No raw AWS credentials, unrestricted database access, arbitrary SQL, or arbitrary mutation API is exposed to the Face compiler.
Face read access never implies TRAN$ACT execution permission.
Published Face definitions must be versioned and auditable.
